_comment: This file is auto-managed by scrape-recipe.js. After the LLM successfully extracts a recipe from a domain for the first time, it saves the CSS selectors here. If a site redesigns its HTML and the selectors stop working, the agent falls back to the LLM and updates this entry automatically.
